subject: The 2AM feature we hid from everyone
preview_text: I built something for you at 2AM last week. Not in the roadmap. Not in any update. Just for you.
body_paragraphs: Two nights ago, at 2AM, I was staring at the same prediction screen you see every day. And I realized something was missing. So I built it. A hidden layer of data that nobody else gets. Not in any release notes, not in any update. Just for you.

I call it the 'Shadow Sheet' — a real-time comparison of our AI's raw confidence vs. the betting market's odds for every match. It shows you where the market is sleeping on a team, and where our AI sees an edge. I wasn't planning to share this, but you've been with us long enough to deserve it.

Open Predictify, go to any upcoming match — Premier League, Champions League, even the Indonesian Liga 1 — and tap the 'Deep Dive' button. You'll see a new tab called 'Market Gap.' That's the Shadow Sheet. It updates every 15 minutes. No other user sees it. Not yet.

Open the app now and check the 'Market Gap' tab on tomorrow's match. See if you spot the 12% edge our AI found on the underdog. P.S. — This feature disappears after 48 hours if no one uses it. Don't let it vanish.
cta_text: Open Predictify and find the hidden tab
